what: Circle diagram below the Q1 instruction in the left column: four concentric magenta circles cut by three blue radii into three equal sectors (one per type of economy), giving twelve label positions. Nine positions are printed as '?'. Three are pre-filled, each set in text curved along its ring: 'Management in private hands' (upper-left sector, outer ring), 'India, Sweden and United Kingdom' (right sector, second ring) and 'Achieving social welfare' (bottom sector, below the outermost ring). The student fills the nine '?' positions with the features of the capitalistic, socialistic and mixed economies.
